memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in all activities of daily living; manages vegetable stall with occasional shortness of breath on climbing stairs.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (negative).
falls: No falls in the past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: 0 regular.
mood: Reports feeling well, denies sadness or anxiety.
carers: Main carer Priya, daughter.
goals: "I want to stay healthy enough to continue selling vegetables at the market."
